body:
## [3.91.0] - 2026-10-01

### Features

- add cheque duplicate validation and localization updates
- add cheque receipt details widget and integrate into payment dialogs

### Bug Fixes

- complete reconciled order side effects
- reconcile recovered orders with exact backend evidence
- reconcile recovered failed orders before retry
- enhance discount precision handling in order history sync with Odoo
- align order history totals and discount precision with Odoo
- preserve finalized refund sync allocations
- ignore phone formatting in customer search (AION-477)
- recheck enrollment across app lifecycle
- skip reminder after customer creation
- hide cheque tenders for negative orders
- reject non-finite cheque totals
- preserve cheque details for gift-card activation receipts
- address cheque payment review findings
- honor POS sync policy for all datasets
- clear orders after cancelled Nayax payments

### Other Changes

- validate release metadata
- complete release metadata
- refresh release metadata
- show pending refund sync state
- avoid timestamp collisions in refund route assertion
- preserve grouped catalog on rank updates
- clarify Z Report payment tables
- Make applied cheque payment summaries read-only
- Preserve keyboard layout and cheque review helpers
- Add cheque payments with inline review and editing
